periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree oblique orientation relative to the sagittal plane of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Near-circular geometry with a slight elongation along the diagonal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering towards the rostrum, creating a teardrop-like extension.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape profile along the posterior margin.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 45% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation, approximately twice the lateral width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semicircular curvature with no visible flattening of the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive rufous-brown discoloration across the typically white dorsal and flank pelage.
